sonnet.problem: Card 8 just told the baker that 'nation will no longer take up the sword against nation.' That makes the false claim in card 9, that the nations keep training for war just in case, easy to answer from the story card. The card also adds a 'just in case' reason that the text doesn't give.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The question asks what 'we' will do, but nothing on any card says who 'we' is. The baker can't tell who is speaking or who is included. The right answer also repeats the question's own wording ('walk in the name'), so it stands out from the other two.
sonnet.rule: "He," "she" and "they" always point to someone the baker can tell.

sonnet.problem: The question restates 'make them a strong nation,' which was the right answer to card 16 ('strong'). That reuses an answer from an earlier card and repeats a fact that was already asked.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
